metallib.note: The tested mlx-sys build inherited the host deployment target for the Metal library. Source supports a macOS 14.0 minimum, but a release must set and verify that target explicitly.

binary_only_with_build_cache_metallib_hi.meaning: expected failure proves mlx.metallib is not embedded

conclusion: Not a single self-contained executable. It is a Python-free, Xcode-free two-file platform archive (binary plus mlx.metallib) using only macOS system libraries at runtime. Model/tokenizer assets remain separate product data.
